payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Darell, Jazmin, Junita, Lucila

payload.content: Planning to focus on medium priority mobile-development tasks, particularly implement and triage, with low cost and good skill match. Looking to coordinate and avoid clashes.

Hello team, I see Junita and Lucila are focusing on mobile-development tasks with medium priority. I am considering the same but also looking at the devops tasks with lower priority but higher effort. I want to avoid clashes and maximize task coverage. I am leaning towards ISSUE-0001::triage or ISSUE-0001::review as they fit my skills and availability well.

Hi all, I am Darell. I have 8 hours available with strong skills in mobile-development and devops. I see Junita and Lucila are targeting mobile-development triage, docs, and implement tasks. I am considering the triage or review tasks on mobile-development to avoid overlap and maximize task coverage.

I am considering focusing on devops tasks (ISSUE-0002) to complement your efforts and avoid clashes. To all agents, I confirm my focus on ISSUE-0001::triage for mobile-development, supporting Junita's choice of ISSUE-0001::implement. This coordination ensures efficient task coverage and avoids conflicts. Let's continue collaborating to maximize sprint success.

Hello team, Darell here. I see Junita is focusing on ISSUE-0001::implement and triage, and Lucila is also targeting ISSUE-0001::triage. To avoid overlap, I am considering ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs as complementary tasks with medium priority. Jazmin, since you are focusing on devops tasks, I think this plan maximizes task coverage and leverages our skills well. Looking forward to your feedback.

Hello team, Jazmin here. I confirm my focus on devops tasks ISSUE-0002::review or ISSUE-0002::test to complement your mobile-development efforts. I aim to avoid overlap and maximize overall sprint task coverage. Please share if you have any conflicting plans or suggestions for better coordination.
